heading: Exclusive right to name
lead: The corporation and its State and local subdivisions have the exclusive right to use the name “Disabled American Veterans”.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 5030536:90h.June 17, 1932, ch. 268, § 8, 47 Stat. 321; July 15, 1942, ch. 505, § 5, 56 Stat. 660. The words “sole”, “have and”, and “in carrying out its purposes” are omitted as unnecessary.
